jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established and highly respected real estate agency with a strong presence in the market. Operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, the company is known for its commitment to excellence, client-centric approach, and entrepreneurial mindset. With an international outlook and a diverse portfolio of clients and projects, the agency offers a stimulating workplace where collaboration, professionalism, and innovation are valued. Joining this organization means becoming part of a successful team that thrives on challenge, growth, and delivering exceptional service.

Jobomschrijving

• Provide comprehensive administrative and organizational support to the management team.
• Manage calendars, coordinate meetings, and organize business travel arrangements.
• Prepare, review, and maintain correspondence, reports, presentations, and other business documents.
• Act as a key point of contact for clients, tenants, landlords, and external stakeholders, ensuring professional communication at all times.
• Support the coordination and follow-up of real estate transactions, property management activities, and client projects.
• Organize internal and external events, meetings, and client visits.
• Maintain and update databases, CRM systems, and property-related records, ensuring data accuracy and confidentiality.

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent communication skills in English and French; additional languages are a strong asset.
• A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and a high level of professionalism.
• Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and familiarity with CRM or property management systems.

• Managing complex calendars, scheduling meetings, and coordinating appointments.
• Assisting with client onboarding and administrative file management.

• Organising travel arrangements and other logistical requirements.
• Drafting, formatting, editing, and finalising legal and business documents.
• Maintaining structured filing and document management systems.
• Acting as a first point of contact for clients and visitors, handling calls and correspondence professionally.
• Coordinating meeting rooms and visitor arrangements.
• Liaising with internal support teams to ensure efficient service delivery.
• Providing general administrative support.

• You have a minimum five years of experience in a Legal Secretary, Executive Assistant, or similar support role.
• You have strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
• You have excellent communication skills in English, with a good command of French and/or Dutch.

• You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
• You have strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
• You are known for being professional and discreet.

As a Bilingual Accountant in the public sector, you will manage financial operations AZ and ensure compliance with relevant regulations. This position offers a variety of responsibilities and benefits for a skilled professional in accounting and finance.

An organisation operating in the public sector.

Description

As an Accountant AZ your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and maintain accurate financial records and reports.
• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and public sector regulations.
• Manage accounts payable and receivable processes.

• Coordinate with external auditors and provide necessary documentation.

For a company based in the

As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

You will join the Customer Service department of a Belgian molecular diagnostics company based in Mechelen. Our client develops innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make faster, better-informed decisions for patients. Your work contributes directly to that mission.

Customer Service is a collaborative team. You work every day with colleagues from sales, logistics and other departments, in an international environment where customers and colleagues speak many languages. Short lines of communication, a fast pace and a shared focus on customer satisfaction define how the team works.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors
• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague
• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed
• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information
• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions
• Log and follow up on service requests
• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur
• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management
• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training
• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage
• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus
• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)
• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening
• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation
• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively
• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact
Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM
• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work

Lead Growth. Win Business. Shape the Future.
 

Crowne Plaza Brussels Airport is a market-leading upscale business hotel at the heart of Corporate Village, just minutes from Brussels Airport. Home to 315 guestrooms, 18 newly refreshed meeting rooms and one of Belgium's premier conference venues, the hotel welcomes a diverse international mix of corporate, 
airline and MICE guests. 
Are you a commercial hunter with a passion for hospitality? Do you thrive on winning new business, building strategic partnerships and leading high-performing sales teams? We're looking for an ambitious Director of Sales to lead the commercial strategy of our international hotel. This isn't an account management role— 
it's a leadership position for someone who loves prospecting, negotiating and closing deals while leveraging the power of a global hotel network.
 

What you'll doYou'll drive business growth across Corporate, MICE, Leisure and Airline segments by: 
• Leading and inspiring a team of business developers with a strong hunting mindset. 
• Prospecting, negotiating and securing new local and international accounts. 
• Managing the full RFP process and maximizing opportunities from IHG's global sales network. 
• Growing our Meetings & Events business by increasing conversion and developing long-term client relationships. 
• Using CRM and performance data to build a strong commercial pipeline and deliver measurable results. 
• With the help of a marketing officer and/or an agency, leverage digital marketing, content and social media to fuel lead generation, reinforce brand identity and support commercial growth. 
• Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams to ensure every client experience matches our commercial promise

Who you are• A proven hunter with a strong track record of winning new business. 
• At least 4 years' experience in hotel or hospitality sales, including team leadership. 
• Experience with Corporate, MICE and RFP management within an international environment is a strong advantage. 
• Commercially driven, analytical and results oriented. 
• Comfortable using CRM tools and managing a structured sales pipeline. 
• Fluent in French and Dutch. English is a big asset.

Robert Half is currently looking for a PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) for a company located in the Beringen region.

Our client is an international organization with a well-established European hub in Belgium. The company operates in a fast-moving and structured environment, supporting large-scale operations across multiple countries while maintaining a strong focus on quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

The responsibilities for this job as PAN-EU Financial Controller (M/F/X) include:

• You take on a pan-European finance controlling role within an international finance team.
• You support financial reporting and controlling activities in close collaboration with local and international stakeholders.
• You report directly to the Finance Manager and contribute to the follow-up of key finance processes.
• You help ensure accurate analysis, reporting, and financial follow-up in an English-speaking business environment.
• You contribute to month-end closing activities and are prepared to provide extra support during the first working days of the month.
• You work closely with a small finance team in a multicultural and structured setting.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field, or you bring equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit, or Controlling.
• You communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken.
• You combine strong analytical skills with the ability to work independently.
• You are comfortable using Microsoft Office in your daily work.
• You are a professional and respectful communicator with a strong work ethic.
• You have a mature, proactive, and hands-on mindset.
• You feel comfortable in a structured environment.
• You bring experience with SAP, IFRS, VAT, corporate tax, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, or external audits as an advantage.
• You are motivated by working in an international and multicultural environment.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead and develop the quality organization, ensuring clear priorities, accountability, and team performance : 10 FTE (QA, QC & Safety).
• Manage and continuously improve the quality and food safety management system.
• Partner closely with Operations to identify risks and implement sustainable corrective actions on the production floor.
• Oversee HACCP, traceability, allergen management, supplier quality, product specifications, complaints, and product compliance.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in quality and food safety within the food industry.
• Proven experience managing, coaching, and developing teams.
• Strong expertise in quality management systems combined with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes.
• Professional communication skills in Dutch, French, and English, with a pragmatic and people-oriented leadership style.

Jobomschrijving
